scene.situation: 03.10.1283 05:49 Shiki directly and precisely asks night duty ICU physician if she sent his own PRIVATE HEALTH DATA unrelated to recipient6's experimental intervention to medical committee WITHOUT HIS CONSENT, citing her earlier words about observed technique, blood changes and staff safety. She unequivocally answers YES: her already-sent internal hospital incident notice included Shiki's full name as procedure participant, observed Byoton name and intervention, collapse, abnormal appearance of blood, and bare-contact safety precaution. She did NOT obtain his consent because he was unconscious, and had not told him scope when he awoke; she defends transmission as necessary for staff protection but admits personal nature of data and her own decision. It did not include his full personal chart, exact body temperature, expanded test values, blood vials or separate lab report; additional readings had been planned but not sent. She shows Shiki exact outgoing notification and retains independent copy, does not lie or retract it. Kadziura sees distinct privacy problem beyond medical report on recipient6, asks documented recipients/scope/legal basis and halts casual further disclosures pending separate internal decision; he cannot retract notification already received. No known formal investigation or criminal charge, report to internal medical commission only. Shiki standing near cot with wholly intact cold pale skin, very low chakra, maximally altered almost-black blood but functioning, no new direct-contact exposure. Recipient6 still ventilated on S17, early bronchial outcome stable. Scene ends on doctor's direct admission and exposed outgoing paper.
scene.positions: Shiki standing independently at bedside with intact gray-cold skin, chakra profoundly depleted. Duty ICU doctor near table with copy of outgoing report, openly acknowledges private data dissemination. Kadziura at table with chain of custody paperwork, deciding scope of any further specimen transfers. Sealed blood specimens remain within medical unit, no further transfer. Patient6 adjacent ICU ventilator on continuing S17.
scene.pressure: Shiki has discovered unauthorized-in-his-eyes medical data release to committee, formally confirmed. Night doctor defends staff protection and preserves documentation, Kadz limits dissemination and insists on documented addressees. No legal finding about wrongdoing predetermined, no criminal matter started. Institutional consequences now real from existing disclosure.
